name_zh: 恩克鲁玛/泛非主义：泛非主义建国与非洲统一梦想
name_en: Nkrumah/Pan-Africanism: Pan-African Nation-Building & African Unity Dream
description_zh: 克瓦梅·恩克鲁玛 (1909-1972) 加纳首任总理/总统 (1957-1966)，撒哈拉以南非洲首个独立国家领袖，泛非主义先驱。核心建国逻辑：非暴力抗争(正面行动/罢工/抵制)→1957 独立→泛非主义制度化(1958 全非人民大会/1963 非统组织 OAU 创始/《非洲必须团结》)→工业化/沃尔特湖/阿克拉姆水电/教育免费→1966 政变流亡几内亚/去世。体现 M186 泛非主义建国——以"非暴力独立+泛非制度化+工业化赶超+非洲合众国梦想"四位一体，在殖民遗产/冷战/部落分裂中构建非洲统一政治主体。
description_en: Kwame Nkrumah (1909-1972) Ghana's first PM/President (1957-1966), first sub-Saharan independent nation leader, Pan-Africanism pioneer. Core nation-building logic: non-violent resistance (positive action/strikes/boycotts) -> 1957 independence -> Pan-African institutionalization (1958 All-African Peoples Conference/1963 OAU founder/'Africa Must Unite') -> industrialization/Volta Lake/Akosombo hydro/education free -> 1966 coup exile Guinea/death. Exemplifies M186 Pan-African Nation-Building—quaternity of 'non-violent independence + Pan-African institutionalization + industrialization catch-up + United States of Africa dream' constructing African unity political subject amid colonial legacy/Cold War/tribal divisions.
reason_zh: 恩克鲁玛非单纯建国者，而是"泛非主义先知+工业化实干家+非洲合众国梦想家"三位一体。以非暴力争取独立，以泛非主义超越部落/殖民边界，以工业化摆脱原料附庸。M186 区隔于 M173 哈希姆合法性(血统)、M170 民族建国(武装)、M187 酋长制(传统)，核心在于"泛非主义即建国纲领+工业化即主权保障+非洲合众国即终极目标"的非洲建国范式。
reason_en: Nkrumah not mere nation-builder but trinity of 'Pan-African prophet + industrialization pragmatist + United States of Africa dreamer'. Non-violent independence, Pan-Africanism transcending tribal/colonial borders, industrialization escaping raw material dependency. M186 distinct from M173 Hashemite Legitimacy (lineage), M170 Nation-Building (armed), M187 Chiefship Co-governance (traditional), core: 'Pan-Africanism as nation-building program + industrialization as sovereignty guarantee + United States of Africa as ultimate goal' African nation-building paradigm.
steps_zh: 非暴力独立动员：正面行动/罢工/抵制/监禁/1951 大选胜利/1957 独立，非暴力成建国合法性
泛非主义制度化：1958 全非人民大会阿克拉/1960 独立非洲国家会议/1963 OAU 亚的斯亚贝巴/《非洲必须团结》/非洲合众国政府构想
工业化赶超战略：沃尔特湖/阿克拉姆大坝/铝业/纺织/造船/七年发展计划/进口替代/科学教育/原子能委员会
非洲合众国梦想与挫折：1963 OAU 妥协/1965 非统组织失败/1966 政变 CIA 指控/流亡科纳克里/几内亚荣誉副总统/1972 病逝布加勒斯特
遗产与复兴：非洲大陆自贸区 AfCFTA/泛非议会/阿非利加统一组织/恩克鲁玛主义复兴/非洲一体化加速
steps_en: Non-violent independence mobilization: positive action/strikes/boycotts/imprisonment/1951 election victory/1957 independence, non-violence as nation-building legitimacy
Pan-African institutionalization: 1958 All-African Peoples Conference Accra/1960 Conference of Independent African States/1963 OAU Addis/'Africa Must Unite'/United States of Africa government vision
Industrialization catch-up strategy: Volta Lake/Akosombo dam/aluminum/textiles/shipbuilding/seven-year plan/import substitution/science education/atomic energy commission
United States of Africa dream & setback: 1963 OAU compromise/1965 United States of Africa fails/1966 coup CIA alleged/exile Conakry/Guinea honorary co-president/1972 dies Bucharest
Legacy & revival: AfCFTA/Pan-African Parliament/AU/Nkrumahism revival/African integration acceleration
expected_zh: 以"非暴力独立+泛非制度化+工业化赶超+非洲合众国梦想"四位一体，在殖民遗产/冷战/部落分裂中构建非洲统一政治主体，为非洲独立运动提供思想与行动双重范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'non-violent independence + Pan-African institutionalization + industrialization catch-up + United States of Africa dream' constructs African unity political subject amid colonial legacy/Cold War/tribal divisions, providing dual paradigm of thought & action for African independence movements.
case_zh: 1957 加纳独立/1958 全非会议/1960 独立非洲会议/1963 OAU 成立/1964 沃尔特湖蓄水/1966 政变流亡/1972 病逝/2000s 非盟/非洲大陆自贸区/泛非议会复兴恩克鲁玛梦想。
case_en: 1957 Ghana independence/1958 All-African Conference/1960 Independent African States Conference/1963 OAU founded/1964 Volta Lake filling/1966 coup exile/1972 death/2000s AU/AfCFTA/Pan-African Parliament reviving Nkrumah dream.
